import request from '@/utils/request'
import type { ApiResponse } from '@/types/common'
import type {
  WorkflowNode,
  WorkflowConnection,
  NodeExecutionResult,
  WorkflowExecution,
} from '@/types/workflow'

/**
 * 获取工作流节点定义列表。
 */
export const getWorkflowNodes = () =>
  request.get<ApiResponse<WorkflowNode[]>>('/admin/workflow/nodes')

/**
 * 获取工作流连接关系。
 */
export const getWorkflowConnections = () =>
  request.get<ApiResponse<WorkflowConnection[]>>('/admin/workflow/connections')

/**
 * 执行单个节点。
 */
export const executeNode = (nodeId: string, inputs: Record<string, any>) =>
  request.post<ApiResponse<NodeExecutionResult>>(`/admin/workflow/nodes/${nodeId}/execute`, inputs)

/**
 * 执行完整工作流（单个学生）。
 */
export const executeWorkflow = (userId: number, questionCount?: number) =>
  request.post<ApiResponse<WorkflowExecution>>('/admin/workflow/execute', null, {
    params: { userId, questionCount },
    timeout: 300_000,
  })

/**
 * 执行批量工作流（多个学生）。
 */
export const executeBatchWorkflow = (userIds: number[], questionCount?: number) =>
  request.post<ApiResponse<WorkflowExecution>>('/admin/workflow/execute-batch', null, {
    params: { userIds, questionCount },
    timeout: 300_000,
  })

/**
 * 获取执行详情。
 */
export const getExecutionDetail = (executionId: string) =>
  request.get<ApiResponse<WorkflowExecution>>(`/admin/workflow/executions/${executionId}`)

/**
 * 获取执行历史。
 */
export const getExecutionHistory = (limit = 20) =>
  request.get<ApiResponse<WorkflowExecution[]>>('/admin/workflow/executions', {
    params: { limit },
  })

/**
 * 工作流节点定义。
 * 模拟 Dify workflow 的节点类型：HTTP节点、LLM节点、代码节点。
 */
export interface WorkflowNode {
  nodeId: string
  nodeName: string
  nodeType: 'HTTP' | 'LLM' | 'CODE' | 'CONDITION' | 'SWITCH' | 'LOOP' | 'PARALLEL' | 'DELAY' | 'TEMPLATE'
  description: string
  icon: string
  model?: string
  /** 画布 X 坐标（由后端提供） */
  x?: number
  /** 画布 Y 坐标（由后端提供） */
  y?: number
  inputs: WorkflowNodeInput[]
  outputs: WorkflowNodeOutput[]
}

export interface WorkflowNodeInput {
  name: string
  label: string
  type: 'number' | 'string' | 'boolean' | 'array' | 'object'
  required: boolean
  defaultValue?: string
}

export interface WorkflowNodeOutput {
  name: string
  label: string
  type: 'number' | 'string' | 'boolean' | 'array' | 'object'
}

/**
 * 节点连接关系。
 */
export interface WorkflowConnection {
  source: string
  target: string
  sourceOutput: string
  targetInput: string
}

/**
 * 节点执行结果。
 */
export interface NodeExecutionResult {
  nodeId: string
  status: 'SUCCESS' | 'FAILED' | 'SKIPPED'
  outputs?: Record<string, any>
  errorMessage?: string
  durationMs: number
}

/**
 * 节点执行记录。
 */
export interface NodeResultRecord {
  nodeId: string
  status: string
  startTime: string
  endTime: string
  durationMs?: number
  errorMessage?: string
}

/**
 * 工作流执行记录。
 */
export interface WorkflowExecution {
  executionId: string
  userId?: number
  status: 'RUNNING' | 'SUCCEEDED' | 'FAILED'
  startTime: string
  endTime?: string
  errorMessage?: string
  nodeResults: NodeResultRecord[]
  result?: Record<string, any>
}

/**
 * 工作流执行请求（单个学生）。
 */
export interface ExecuteWorkflowRequest {
  userId: number
  questionCount?: number
}

/**
 * 工作流执行请求（多个学生）。
 */
export interface ExecuteBatchWorkflowRequest {
  userIds: number[]
  questionCount?: number
}

/**
 * 班级统计信息。
 */
export interface ClassStats {
  totalStudents: number
  totalExams: number
  averageScore: number
  averageAccuracy: number
  totalWrongQuestions: number
  avgExamsPerStudent: number
  avgWrongPerStudent: number
}

/**
 * 薄弱点分布。
 */
export interface WeakDistribution {
  categoryName: string
  totalWrong: number
  totalAttempt: number
  wrongRate: number
  studentCount: number
}

/**
 * 成绩分布。
 */
export interface ScoreDistribution {
  excellent: number
  good: number
  medium: number
  poor: number
  excellentRate: number
  goodRate: number
  mediumRate: number
  poorRate: number
}

/**
 * 个人分析。
 */
export interface IndividualAnalysis {
  userId: number
  username: string
  realName: string
  averageScore: number
  overallAccuracy: number
  totalExams: number
  totalWrong: number
  weakestCategory: string
  rank: number
}

/* AI 验证 */
const validating = ref(false)
const validationResult = ref<{
  isValid: boolean
  confidence: number
  suggestions: string[]
  correctedAnswer?: string
  improvedAnalysis?: string
} | null>(null)

const doValidate = async () => {
  if (!formRef.value || activeTab.value === 'READING') return
  // 将当前 tab 赋值给 questionType
  normalForm.questionType = activeTab.value
  await formRef.value.validate(async (valid) => {
    if (!valid) return

    let standardAnswer: string
    if (activeTab.value === 'MULTIPLE') {
      if (!normalForm.answerMulti.length) return
      standardAnswer = [...normalForm.answerMulti].sort().join(',')
    } else if (activeTab.value === 'JUDGE') {
      if (!normalForm.answerJudge) return
      standardAnswer = normalForm.answerJudge
    } else if (activeTab.value === 'FILL_HINT' || activeTab.value === 'FILL') {
      if (!normalForm.answerFill.trim()) return
      standardAnswer = normalForm.answerFill.trim().toUpperCase()
    } else {
      if (!normalForm.answerSingle) return
      standardAnswer = normalForm.answerSingle
    }

    validating.value = true
    validationResult.value = null
    try {
      const res = await validateQuestion({
        questionType: normalForm.questionType,
        stem: normalForm.stem,
        options:
          normalForm.options.length > 0
            ? normalForm.options.map((o) => ({
                optionLabel: o.optionLabel,
                optionContent: o.optionContent,
              }))
            : undefined,
        standardAnswer,
        analysis: normalForm.analysis,
      })
      validationResult.value = res.data
      if (res.data.isValid) {
        ElMessage.success(`AI验证通过，置信度 ${res.data.confidence}%`)
      } else {
        ElMessage.warning('AI验证未通过，请查看建议')
      }
    } catch {
      ElMessage.error('AI验证失败')
    } finally {
      validating.value = false
    }
  })
}

/* 阅读理解批量提交：先建文章，再逐个建题目 */
const submittingReading = ref(false)
const submitReadingBatch = async () => {
  if (!readingForm.passageContent.trim()) {
    ElMessage.warning('请输入或选择文章内容')
    return
  }
  if (readingForm.subQuestions.length === 0) {
    ElMessage.warning('请至少添加一道题目')
    return
  }

  // 校验每道题
  for (let i = 0; i < readingForm.subQuestions.length; i++) {
    const q = readingForm.subQuestions[i]
    if (!q.stem.trim()) {
      ElMessage.warning(`第 ${i + 1} 题题干不能为空`)
      return
    }
    if (q.options.length < 2) {
      ElMessage.warning(`第 ${i + 1} 题至少需要 2 个选项`)
      return
    }
    if (!q.standardAnswer) {
      ElMessage.warning(`请选择第 ${i + 1} 题的正确答案`)
      return
    }
  }

  submittingReading.value = true
  try {
    let passageId = readingForm.selectedPassageId

    // 如果是新建模式，先创建文章
    if (readingForm.passageMode === 'create' || !passageId) {
      const passageRes = await createReadingPassage({
        categoryId: readingForm.categoryId,
        title: readingForm.passageTitle,
        content: readingForm.passageContent,
        difficulty: readingForm.difficulty,
        passageType: readingForm.passageType || undefined,
        topic: readingForm.topic || undefined,
        source: readingForm.source,
        summary: readingForm.summary,
        status: 1,
        isTemp: readingForm.source === 'TEMP',
        questions: readingForm.subQuestions.map((q) => ({
          stem: q.stem,
          standardAnswer: q.standardAnswer,
          analysis: q.analysis,
          knowledgePoints: q.knowledgePoints,
          options: q.options,
          defaultScore: q.defaultScore,
        })),
      })
      passageId = passageRes.data.id
    } else {
      // 使用已有文章，逐个添加题目
      for (const q of readingForm.subQuestions) {
        const item: ReadingQuestionItem = {
          stem: q.stem,
          standardAnswer: q.standardAnswer,
          analysis: q.analysis,
          knowledgePoints: q.knowledgePoints,
          options: q.options,
          defaultScore: q.defaultScore,
        }
        await addPassageQuestion(passageId, item)
      }
    }

    ElMessage.success(
      `创建成功：${readingForm.subQuestions.length} 道阅读理解题`
    )
    dialogVisible.value = false
    load()
  } catch (e) {
    ElMessage.error('创建失败')
  } finally {
    submittingReading.value = false
  }
}

const exportCsv = () => {
  if (!list.value.length) {
    ElMessage.warning('当前列表无数据')
    return
  }
  exporting.value = true
  try {
    const headers = ['ID', '题干', '分类', '题型', '难度', '默认分值', '状态', '引用次数', '陷阱', 'AI生成', '标准答案', '知识点']
    const rows = list.value.map((q) => [
      q.id,
      q.stem,
      q.categoryName ?? '',
      q.questionType,
      q.difficulty,
      q.defaultScore ?? '',
      q.status === 1 ? '启用' : '停用',
      q.usageCount ?? 0,
      q.hasTrap ? '是' : '否',
      q.aiGenerated ? '是' : '否',
      q.standardAnswer ?? '',
      (q.knowledgePoints ?? []).join(';'),
    ].map(escapeCsv).join(','))
    const csv = '\ufeff' + headers.join(',') + '\n' + rows.join('\n')
    const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv;charset=UTF-8' })
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob)
    const a = document.createElement('a')
    a.href = url
    a.download = `题目数据-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.csv`
    document.body.appendChild(a)
    a.click()
    a.remove()
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url)
    ElMessage.success(`已导出 ${list.value.length} 条数据`)
  } finally {
    exporting.value = false
  }
}

/* CSV 导入 */
const importDialogVisible = ref(false)
const importFile = ref<File | null>(null)
const importing = ref(false)
const importResult = ref<{ successCount: number; failedCount: number; errors?: string[] } | null>(null)
const uploadRef = ref<UploadInstance>()

const openImportDialog = () => {
  importFile.value = null
  importResult.value = null
  importDialogVisible.value = true
}

const handleFileChange = (file: { raw: File } | File) => {
  importFile.value = ('raw' in file ? file.raw : file) as File
}

const handleImport = async () => {
  if (!importFile.value) {
    ElMessage.warning('请先选择 CSV 文件')
    return
  }
  importing.value = true
  importResult.value = null
  try {
    const res = await importQuestions(importFile.value)
    importResult.value = res.data
    if (res.data.failedCount === 0) {
      ElMessage.success(`成功导入 ${res.data.successCount} 条`)
      importDialogVisible.value = false
      load()
    } else {
      ElMessage.warning(`成功 ${res.data.successCount} 条，失败 ${res.data.failedCount} 条`)
    }
  } catch {
    ElMessage.error('导入失败')
  } finally {
    importing.value = false
  }
}
